comment.body: Thanks for the recording, the 0.101.2362 confirmation and the clarification that Open Remote Desktop Client also reproduces. The remaining maintainer question is the Command Palette-specific version shown at the bottom of its General settings, and whether CmdPal/PowerToys run as administrator. Could you confirm those two values? If you retest, type only harmless dummy text, not a password, because the report shows input can remain in hidden CmdPal.
